initialize_finetuning_model: initialize a finetuning model from a checkpoint file with optional head overrides and strict loading
compute_loss: compute the loss dictionary for a sequence of MLIP tasks given model predictions and a data batch
compute_metrics: compute evaluation metrics for a given MLIP task using model predictions and a data batch
convert_train_checkpoint_to_inference_ch: convert a DCP training checkpoint into a torch save inference checkpoint at a given path
MLIPTrainEvalUnit: create an MLIP train and eval unit with DDP or FSDP strategy, optimizer, cosine LR scheduler, and EMA support
